messages:
deploy-bot: Release candidate rc_2026_03_21 triggered canary deployment to prod-eu-priv.

deploy-bot: Gate: SBOM check FAILED for artifact redwood-service:1.42.0-rc (missing license metadata for package 'libqwe'). Logs:
```
SBOM scan: missing field 'license' for dependency libqwe@0.9.2
vuln-scan: no vulns found
```

sarah: hitting ping. Is this a hard hold? :eyes:

matt: from sec POV missing license metadata -> risk: legal/regulatory for EU customers. We usually require either a license field or a documented exception. Recommend timeboxed hold + evidence request.

jenny: current change window closes in 2.5 hours. Options: (A) short exception approval (legal+sec) to proceed, (B) pin to last signed image (1.41.3) and continue, (C) rollback full canary. Thoughts?

alex: quick check: 1.41.3 has same libqwe version but signed SBOM present. Pin would be fastest. Patch to add license metadata will take ~3-4 hours to get through build + sign.

matt: legal not on thread yet. I'll @jenny to pull legal. Also, is there any policy block from deploybot for missing SBOM field (auto-block)?

deploy-bot: Automode: SBOM_FIELD_REQUIRED triggered -> automatic canary pause. Manual override possible via `/deploy override sbom-metadata --reason "timeboxed exception" --expires-in 180m` (requires sec+legal approval).

jenny: @matt please loop legal. I'm in favor of pin+note in release notes calling out follow-up. We can keep canary live on eu-private by pinning route to 1.41.3 and continue verification.

matt: agreed. I'll ping Legal.

matt: Legal (ana-legal) approved timeboxed exception? @ana-legal any update? :pray:

ana-legal: ana-legal: We can approve a 3-hour exception if Sec documents compensating controls and a patch ETA. Need a signed follow-up plan in release notes and a ticket assigned.

sarah: Plan: pin canary to `redwood-service:1.41.3` now, file ticket INF-4123 for metadata patch + sign, note in release notes: "Canary pinned due to missing SBOM license field for libqwe; patch ETA 3-4h; will resume rollout after signed SBOM." I'll run the pin.

sarah: `/deploy pin redwood-service canary 1.41.3 --reason "SBOM missing license field"`

deploy-bot: Action accepted. Route updated: canary -> redwood-service:1.41.3. Canary resumed.

jenny: I'll add release note bullet and create the INF ticket. Also set rollback plan if patch doesn't land before change window close: staged rollback to baseline 1.40.0 (last stable) and notify oncall.

alex: ack. I'll standby for the patch build.

sarah: leaving this thread open. If anyone sees new SBOM evidence push it here. :mag:

ops-bot: Notified #oncall: canary pinned to 1.41.3 due to SBOM metadata exception. Tagging oncall rotation.
